Presentation Folder

Make a lasting first impression with our professional presentation folders, designed to keep your materials organized and your brand front and center. Each folder features two spacious interior pockets, perfect for holding brochures, proposals, contracts, spec sheets, or any loose documents you need to present in a polished, cohesive package.

Built for practicality, each pocket has an option to include a die-cut slit, specifically sized for business cards, so your contact information stays neatly in place. It's a small detail that makes a big difference when a client or prospect reaches for your card after a meeting.
